description: Stremio addon: new Indian movies & series on Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hulu and Zee5, from the daily Access Bollywood monitor (Hindi-first). IMDb-matched, with posters.
name: stremio-access-bollywood

scripts.test: node -e "const a=require('./addon'); console.log(a.manifest.catalogs.length + ' catalogs'); console.log('alerts movie:', a.catalogMetas('ab-alerts-movie','movie').length); console.log('alerts series:', a.catalogMetas('ab-alerts-series','series').length);"
scripts.build: node update-from-snapshot.js && node enrich.js && node export-static.js
